caption: The young generation was beaten up mercilessly. Yet we were dignified in our response. But Amit Shah, the one who gave the orders, must face accountability. Why is he not appearing in the Parliament for the past two weeks? He should answer why he ordered pellet guns and brutality.

The young generation was beaten up mercilessly. Yet we were dignified in our response. But Amit Shah, the one who gave the orders, must face accountability. Why is he not appearing in the Parliament for the past two weeks? He should answer why he ordered pellet guns and brutality.

𝐔𝐧𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐇𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐌𝐢𝐧𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐒𝐡𝐫𝐢 [@amitshahofficial](https://www.instagram.com/amitshahofficial/) 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐰𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐋𝐨𝐤 𝐒𝐚𝐛𝐡𝐚 𝐒𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐫 𝐎𝐦 𝐁𝐢𝐫𝐥𝐚, 𝐮𝐫𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚 𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐜𝐮𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐇𝐨𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐮𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐦𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐍𝐄𝐄𝐓 𝐞𝐱𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧.

Now Rahul Gandhi is caught in his own web of lies and deceit. He demanded a discussion. The government is ready to discuss it.

But he can neither run away from the debate nor sit through it without being exposed.

𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐇𝐨𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐰𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠. 𝐖𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐑𝐚𝐡𝐮𝐥 𝐆𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐡𝐢 𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐰 𝐮𝐩?
When a man lacks the courage to speak the truth, his silence speaks for him. Amit Shah’s silence is his confession.

No explanation. No accountability. Just silence.

Democracy demands transparency, not secret restrictions and automated acknowledgements.

[@meta](https://www.instagram.com/meta/), stop hiding behind silence. Tell India why accounts are being restricted on your platforms and whose orders you are acting on.

Despite several emails, why are we still not getting a response?

Stop bowing down to Prime Minister Modi.

This ought to be very clear. The Parliament of India is ours. It is the people’s. The people of India, its children, were brutally beaten up, some blinded for life, by the Delhi Police and the RAF which is under the CRPF a central force.

Hence, their boss, Home Minister Amit Shah ought to answer for their crimes. Why is he not appearing before the Parliament for the last two weeks and answering for his force’s draconian brutality? After all, accountability ought to be fixed. Why is the Speaker Om Birla unable to compel the government to answer? It is his duty to remain impartial. Speakers that are coloured and politically biased ought to be made answerable too.

It is not a radical demand of the MPs to hold Amit Shah answerable before the Parliament for the Black Day that is 20th July 2026. It is a legitimate demand that should be IMMEDIATELY met so our Parliament functions.
